observations: Photo 0: A black office chair with armrests and a five-star base with casters, next to a desk with a dark wood top and white metal legs. The desk has a three-drawer pedestal with light wood finish and metal handles. The floor is patterned wood laminate, and the wall shows some stains or damage.
Photo 1: Same setup from a slightly different angle, showing a window with metal bars. The desk and chair are in the same position. The desk top has a circular cutout, possibly for cable management.

Photo 2: Closer view of the desk and drawer unit. The desk top shows minor scuffs and smudges. The drawer unit has three drawers with metal handles. The white metal legs of the desk are visible, and the floor is the same patterned laminate.
No brand or model visible on any part of the furniture.
The chair appears to be made of faux leather with stitching details. The desk top is laminated wood veneer.

risks.risk: The desk or chair may have structural damage not visible in the photos, such as wobbling legs, loose joints, or internal drawer damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the chair being sat on and rotated, and the desk being pushed to test stability, plus close-ups of drawer mechanisms and leg connections.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or damaged

risks.risk: The chair may have worn-out casters or a broken gas lift mechanism.
risks.proof: A close-up video of the chair’s base and casters being moved, and the height adjustment being tested.

risks.risk: The desk top may have hidden cracks or delamination under the surface, especially near the edges or cutouts.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the desk edges and cutouts, showing the underside and corners.

proof_requests: Video of the chair being sat on and adjusted in height, and rotated to test casters and gas lift.
Video of the desk being pushed to test leg stability and drawer functionality.
Close-up photos of the desk edges, cutouts, and underside for damage.
Proof of purchase or usage timeline if available.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an office desk and chair set, but critical functional and structural risks cannot be assessed from the current photos.
